findings.description: CON-BUILD-006 AC-1 counts compileOnly as main; AC-3 (Gson) and AC-5 (SLF4J) demand an exclusive main dependency, while CON-BUILD-011 AC-1 adds the compileOnly nullability library to modules with public API (which include the Gson and SLF4J modules). The ACs contradict each other.
findings.suggested_action: Limit AC-3/AC-5 exclusivity to api/implementation/runtimeOnly, or exempt the CON-BUILD-011 compileOnly annotation library.

findings.description: AC-1 'declares the main dependencies of all nine modules' has no reference set, and 'no later wave adds a main dependency' cannot be verified in wave 1.
findings.suggested_action: Enumerate the expected graph from D-010/D-011/D-012/D-016/D-026/D-228/D-384/D-386 (+NaruServe-api for every other module); move the later-wave clause to run-end verification.

findings.description: AC-1 needs end-of-run state while target is wave-1; wave-1 evidence cannot cover it.
findings.suggested_action: Make the wave-1 AC 'after the wave-1 build'; leave end-of-run to I-006 final verification.

findings.description: AC-4 turns wave decision W2-004 (declared to add no requirement) into a system AC about serial orchestration; the TinyHttpd .gitignore already ignores build.
findings.suggested_action: Drop AC-4; the §3 assumption already covers serial waves.

findings.description: The forbidden-package check scope ('NaruServe-api class') would hit Kotlin test classes in NaruServe-api that reference kotlin.*.
findings.suggested_action: Restrict to the main source set classes of NaruServe-api.

findings.description: 'modules with public API' is vague; a positive Kotlin call does not tell a nullable type from a platform type.
findings.suggested_action: Name the modules; specify a compile fixture where assigning the @Nullable return to a non-null type fails compilation.

findings.description: All 16 requirements have Stability=draft (SRS-W023 x16); CLAUDE.md requires stopping before implementing draft.
findings.suggested_action: Raise each requirement to evolving with per-requirement MCP update_stability after the gate passes.

findings.description: AC-3 tag [W-bootstrap-name] is not an ID in the research docs; AC-1 adopts the issue-proposed names without saying so in the rationale.
findings.suggested_action: Retag to D-002/wave decision; cite the #1 proposal in the rationale.

findings.description: A missing includeBuild dir fails while settings.gradle is evaluated (initialization), not in the 'configuration phase'.
findings.suggested_action: Reword as 'before any task runs, while Gradle evaluates settings.gradle'.
Say 'a file under docs/ or CLAUDE.md' (file choice left to C-07).

findings.description: The Code settings.gradle 'implements' trace does not implement the read-only/deferred-issue rule.
findings.suggested_action: Remove it or replace it with Issue #1 tracks.

findings.description: I-004 (Android-targeted modules free of javax.servlet) has a subject after wave 1 and is not covered.
findings.suggested_action: Optionally add an AC, or note it is checked at the wave-1 merge.

findings.description: KGP 2.x JVM-target validation may reject jvmTarget 1.8 against JavaCompile targetCompatibility 17 when only options.release=8 is set.
findings.suggested_action: Implementation Note: also set java source/targetCompatibility 1.8.

findings.description: AC-2 lacks 'passes on the wave 1 dependency set'.
